clips.title: The story
paras: Supplies to Tannok is an errand entrusted to fledgling adventurers departing Coldridge Valley through the dangerous mountain pass into greater Dun Morogh. The gnome tinkerer Hands Springsprocket sends a crate of needed provisions to Tannok Frosthammer at the Thunderbrew Distillery inn in Kharanos, bypassing the trogg-infested trails that have severed routine trade.

Coldridge Valley is traditionally the proving ground and sanctuary for young Ironforge dwarves and exiled Gnomeregan survivors, but recent events have strained its connection to the rest of Dun Morogh. Trogg incursions have overrun Coldridge Pass, leaving the mountain defile perilous to cross. Mountaineers are spread thin guarding settlements and defensive perimeters, delaying scheduled supply escorts for days on end.

Hands Springsprocket, a gnome waiting by the mouth of Coldridge Pass, found himself saddled with a crate of vital inn supplies meant for Kharanos without any safe way to deliver it personally. Recognizing that hearty adventurers are already preparing to brave the perilous pass, he enlists outward-bound travelers to carry the cargo to Tannok Frosthammer, the assistant at the bustling Thunderbrew inn.

Reaching Kharanos marks an adventurer's entry into the broader world of Dun Morogh. Tannok Frosthammer eagerly receives the delivery, noting that word from Anvilmar has been scarce ever since the troggs disrupted travel through the pass. Delivering the goods restores a fragile line of communication and trade between the two isolated dwarf communities.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hey! You look like a hearty adventurer. If you're planning on braving the pass, do you suppose you could bring a package to the inn in Kharanos?
You were planning on stopping at the inn, right? If you make it through the pass, you'll definitely want to take a breather there.
Anyways, bring this to Tannok Frosthammer, the innkeeper's assistant. I can't get through the pass myself, and it'll be days until a Mountaineer escort comes through!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hi there! Come in, take a seat by the fire and warm yourself with a flagon of ale.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, at last, the supplies from Hands! I was beginning to worry, we've had scarce word from Anvilmar ever since the troggs overran the pass.
Thanks for bringing this to me, friend. And please, make yourself comfortable. You must be tired after your journey.
